audit_program:
import json,re,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
b=Path("/home/sasaki/datasets/openloris/corridor1-1-m8-bounded-native-v1")
runs={}
for arm in ("control","candidate-a","candidate-b"):
 root=b/"boundary-1k"
 log=(root/(arm+".log")).read_text(); time=(root/(arm+".time")).read_text()
 assert "Exit status: 0" in time
 hashes={}
 for n in ("cameras.txt","images.txt","points3D.txt"):
  data=(root/arm/"model"/n).read_bytes()
  ref=b/"legacy/model" if arm=="control" else root/"candidate-a/model"
  assert data==(ref/n).read_bytes()
  hashes[n]=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
 assert "registered_frames=500/500 registered_images=1000/1000" in log
 runs[arm]=dict(model_sha256=hashes,mapper_seconds=float(re.search(r"mapper_seconds=([0-9.]+)",log)[1]),peak_rss_kib=int(re.search(r"Maximum resident set size \(kbytes\): (\d+)",time)[1]),log=log,time_output=time)
print(json.dumps(runs))
